notes.title: Discontinue new features now live
notes.notes:
Discontinue has been updated with new features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35135330/b011f5c7f4948dc52599f51f72d4c6c71c69bb19.png[/img]

[b]New features in this update:[/b]
* LIV has been integrated into Discontinue, Record yourself or an avatar playing the game and create a mixed reality experience.
* You can now gain Steam Achievements in Discontinue.
* Small bug fixes

Check out this video for LIV footage:
[previewyoutube=hD6t-wNLfe8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Discontinue major update to V1.10
notes.notes:
Here is a brand new update for Discontinue.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35135330/f2d23c58fed4283a38693e07b12ad41c7e057176.png[/img]
https://youtu.be/bJotZ1Gzrtc

It's [b]version 1.10[/b] and contains all sorts of new stuff.
Based on reviews of the community here are some initial new features:
- Level difficulty indicator
- Chinese (simplified) language support.
- More audio tracks.
- Various level sceneries based on Audio and level difficulty. 
- Enhanced menu's with Quit buttons and slight design changes.

Because the reviews are much appreciated there are more features in the works to provide you with an even better Virtual Reality game. 
Please keep the reviews coming. And also if you write or post a video review somewhere please email discontinue@postbeta.com with a link so it can be shared.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1834583133
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1834582147

notes.title: A Demo for Discontinue is now available
notes.notes:
Would you like to try [b]Discontinue[/b]?
This is now possible. Download the [b]Demo [/b]and experience the game.

It includes:
- One training area
- One example level (lvl 2000)
- And a time limit for both options.

[i][b]Will you become the champion of level 2000?[/b][/i]

Have fun!

notes.title: Discontinue now also available for Oculus Rift
notes.notes:
[b]Since the latest update Discontinue now also supports the Oculus Rift besides the HTC Vive head-mounted display.[/b]

The Steam version does not yet support the Rift S, this is something we are working hard on  and will share in the future.

If after our extensive testing an issue might still occur on your side, please inform us and we will try to resolve it as soon as possible.

Also we would love to hear from you, please share your experience with Discontinue so we can learn from what you think could be done better and from what you enjoy when playing the game.



Thank you and have fun.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1061220/Discontinue

notes.title: Upcoming VR support: Oculus Rift
notes.notes:
[u]More VR HMD support on the horizon.[/u]

Currently Discontinue supports the [b]HTC Vive[/b] head-mounted display.

And we are currently working on support for the [b]Oculus Rift[/b] and [b]Oculus Rift S[/b] head-mounted displays.

PS. If you have any recommendations for the game, please let us know.
